anomalies.observation: Historical edit form can return checked=true while summary/archive says present. In the 14-fixture audit six such false-positive edit states were observed and no false-negative edit state was observed.
anomalies.authority_rule: For historical revision, summary/archive absent is authoritative; retain edit checkbox value only as provenance/discrepancy evidence.
anomalies.failure_rule: A new mismatch shape is not automatically accepted; strict fixture gate must fail until reviewed.

anomalies.observation: Multiple canonical tutorial IDs can share the same student_uid, tutorial_ts and tutorial_type.
anomalies.authority_rule: tutorial_id from tutorial-list API remains canonical identity; collision candidate source states remain group-owned and are never positionally assigned by list order.
anomalies.failure_rule: Divergent, incomplete, or legacy ambiguous-unknown collision state must not be treated as proven per-ID ownership and must block revision-by-ID.

anomalies.observation: One observed same-timestamp collision has two distinct summary states (present vs absent) while edit/print timestamp route resolves to only the absent state.
anomalies.authority_rule: Preserve all API IDs and all source states separately. Timestamp-only route state is group evidence, not a discriminator. Identical candidate states may be used only through shared-identical authority; divergent association remains ambiguous.
anomalies.failure_rule: Revision-by-ID of a divergent ambiguous collision fails closed until a future proven discriminator changes the governed association authority.

anomalies.observation: Historical Standard edit form can have blank hidden input trecs-79 while visible #tcinput contenteditable contains the historical aims.
anomalies.authority_rule: Historical semantic Aims text comes from #tcinput contenteditable; retain source editor HTML and hidden-input state only as provenance/raw evidence, never as alternate editable values.

anomalies.observation: Print fallback can render placeholders such as none for a field that is explicitly blank in summary.
anomalies.authority_rule: Summary field presence is authoritative even when blank; print may supplement only a missing summary key.

anomalies.observation: GEL overall-level option uses Ao: beginner while skill-level selects use A0.
anomalies.authority_rule: Normalize Ao to semantic A0; retain the literal overall-level GEL value only as source/provenance evidence, never as an editable or POST fallback value.

anomalies.observation: Summary renders seven assessment values as one composite row and may contain presentation artefacts; edit form exposes seven structured radio groups.
anomalies.authority_rule: For exact form reconstruction prefer structured edit-form radio values; archive may parse summary composite when edit evidence is unavailable.
